entry.title: [NEWS] Backdoor in Claude Code for VS Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace
[NEWS] Claude Code regularly sends each background agent’s transcript to its model
[NEW] `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT` to set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's
entry.content:
Try: ~/.codex/config.toml → [features] multi_agent = true, hooks = true

Parallel subagents and lifecycle hooks, the same shape as Claude Code's.

entry.title: [SKIP] Ponytail: useful, but not a token saver
entry.content:
Judge it on code size, not tokens. Viral videos claim 50%+ token savings; the top reply cites the docs saying that is not its purpose.

Reported 3,629 -> 490 lines on one task; the savings claim is disputed.

entry.title: [SKIP] Treat "unlimited free usage" routers with suspicion
entry.content:
Before installing a router that pools free third-party providers, read its source: your prompts and code pass through it. Unverified community warning, not a confirmed finding.

A plugin-stack video promoting one drew a 'do not install' reply; verify yourself.
